goals: Friends Only identity and quieter native Home/navigation
Home posts from followed authors only according to explicit native relationship metadata

checks.fixed_build_issue: The pinned resource encoder rejected new named palette values even after PublicXmlManager allocation. Palette colors are now typed literals in the exact semantic/launch attributes and launch drawables; no new named color resources or existing color ID edits are needed.
checks.independent_runtime_review: No release-blocking code defect found in bounded chrome, lifecycle, input, theme, accessibility, config or Home filter; physical behavior untested.
checks.aapt2_new_drawable_compile_and_link: passed using Android 35 framework, actual selectors/day-night launch XML with a mock own icon and two source attribute stubs; not a full Instagram APK test

home_filter.decision: Keep ordinary Home media only with following == Boolean.TRUE and injected == null. Missing, false, inaccessible or unexpected metadata is hidden. Wrapped non-post units lacking primary media are skipped by the existing native null guard.

quiet_design.home_header: Friends Only plus visible local settings button
quiet_design.native_glyphs_and_bottom_numeric_badges: covered or hidden only on the three known native tabs
quiet_design.os_splash_branding: own icon and neutral canvas, original Meta branding image removed from launcher style
quiet_design.internal_startup_logo: own icon replacement only for exact named MainActivity startup ImageView within bounded main-wrapper scan
quiet_design.dark_light: own neutral families and actual native theme-background resolution for runtime chrome

limits: Followed posts with missing relationship metadata may be hidden, producing a shorter or empty Home feed.
Changing follow filter requires refreshing already displayed items.
A stored disabled following filter can briefly use the strict default until native tab/preferences initialization on cold start; refresh may be needed.
Disk-cache and alternate-render bypasses are not verified.
No chronology, completeness or live server/account feed guarantee is established by static tests.
Original post, Story, Direct and profile components remain; unfamiliar or unverified native surfaces keep original behavior.
Physical alpha.3 installation/Home are user-confirmed; user explicitly has not tested alpha.4, and alpha.5 is not phone-tested.
Test builds use disposable signing unless stable repository secrets are configured; replacement can require removing only Friends Only.
